top_signals.title: Treasury sanctions 17 tankers linked to Iran's 'shadow fleet' in economic pressure campaign
top_signals.summary: The additional sanctions are part of the Trump administration's military and economic campaign against Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan Deal Drought Cuts IPO Fundraising to Lowest in 14 Years
top_signals.summary: Fundraising through initial public offerings in Japan is drying up, in contrast to a dealmaking boom across Asia, after regulatory changes and a dearth of artificial intelligence related companies depleted up the listings pipeline.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. military to livestream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter
top_signals.summary: Nidal Hasan's execution will be the first by the U.S. military since 1961, and the first it has carried out by firing squad since World War II.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
